title: Sample review
description: Three items that show the pane kinds and the highlight. Run with: npm run sample

items.header: Does the English paragraph mention documentation examples?
items.detail: This item asks for the phone viewport: the page renders at 390×844 as a mobile browser, scaled to fit. Press V to cycle viewports.

items.header: Find the infobox row for the stable release
items.detail: A partial match on a table header highlights the value cell next to it.

items.header: Which Wikipedia layout reads better for this article?
items.detail: Two live pages. G shows them side by side with synced scrolling (S toggles it); F crossfades captures of them; W puts a draggable divider between the captures. The answer buttons are the sources.
pane.src can be a local path relative to this task file, or an http(s) URL. Click the image to toggle 1:1.
